explanations.observableCause: The declared bundle has missing, invalid or disallowed patch metadata. Its manifest declaration does not supply an observable loader contribution.
unknowns: Runtime failure and plugin behavior: not observed / not-run.
Final composition: unknown. Home/CLI overlays and installation-level bundles are not inspected by the default static reader.
explanations.manualRemediation: Review the bundle manifest → dsh.bundle.patch and packaged YAML file. Check the publisher tarball contents; do not substitute or execute a file suggested by the log.
